title: Hold a licence to operate a crematorium
what: Operate a crematorium (a facility for cremation or another prescribed process for disposing of human remains) only under a licence; cemeteries are declared by the Minister, not licensed.

sources.title: Burial and Cremation Act 2022 (NT)
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if: (a) the person intentionally operates a facility; and (b) the person does not hold a licence to operate the facility under section 123(1)

sources.title: Burial and Cremation Act 2022 (NT)
sources.quote: facility means a place or premises, whether fixed or mobile, for cremation or any other process prescribed by regulation for the disposal of human remains

administration.who: Minister administering the Burial and Cremation Act 2022 (NT)
